description:
Title: Farming Bot

Players want to create custom farming bots, that help them gather resources.
First you have to find out which resources you want.
Up to 10 resources in parallel can be collected, some resources are more urgently needed than others.
Some resources are required to create tools that are needed to gather other resources (create a custom logic of the dependencies in your game).
After all preferences are collected, your bot starts farming.
Sometimes,  random natural disasters strike and set your bot back.
Whenever some milestones are reached, you are notified.
During farming it is possible to update the list of to be farmed materials (at all times).
After the bot is finished, you should be able to brag to selected friends and/or send them materials.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_FarmingBot" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/farming-bot">
  <bpmn:signal id="Signal_NaturalDisaster" name="Natural disaster strikes"/>
  <bpmn:signal id="Signal_MilestoneReached" name="Milestone reached"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_UpdateMaterialsList" name="Update materials list requested"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_FarmingBot" name="Farming Bot" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_BotRequested" name="Player wants a farming bot"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectResources" name="Select resources to farm"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SetUrgency" name="Set resource urgency"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DefineDependencies" name="Define tool dependencies"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FarmMerge" name="Farming start or resume"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_FarmResources" name="Farm resources">
      <bpmn:documentation>Up to 10 resources can be collected in parallel.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_RecoverBot" name="Recover bot after disaster"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_NotifyMilestone" name="Notify player of milestone"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_UpdateMaterialsList" name="Update list of materials to farm"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_MilestoneNotified" name="Milestone notified"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ListUpdated" name="Materials list updated"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OutcomeSplit" name="Brag and/or send materials"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_BragToFriends" name="Brag to selected friends"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SendMaterials" name="Send materials to selected friends"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OutcomeJoin" name="Sharing done"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_BotFinished" name="Bot finished"/>

    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="BoundaryEvent_Disaster" name="Natural disaster strikes" attachedToRef="Task_FarmResources" cancelActivity="true">
      <bpmn:signalEventDefinition id="SignalDef_Disaster" signalRef="Signal_NaturalDisaster"/>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="BoundaryEvent_Milestone" name="Milestone reached" attachedToRef="Task_FarmResources" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:signalEventDefinition id="SignalDef_Milestone" signalRef="Signal_MilestoneReached"/>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="BoundaryEvent_UpdateList" name="Materials list update requested" attachedToRef="Task_FarmResources" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageDef_UpdateList" messageRef="Message_UpdateMaterialsList"/>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_BotRequested" targetRef="Task_SelectResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_SelectResources" targetRef="Task_SetUrgency"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_SetUrgency" targetRef="Task_DefineDependencies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_DefineDependencies" targetRef="Gateway_FarmMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_FarmMerge" targetRef="Task_FarmResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_FarmResources" targetRef="Gateway_OutcomeSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="BoundaryEvent_Disaster" targetRef="Task_RecoverBot"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_RecoverBot" targetRef="Gateway_FarmMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="BoundaryEvent_Milestone" targetRef="Task_NotifyMilestone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_NotifyMilestone" targetRef="EndEvent_MilestoneNotified"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="BoundaryEvent_UpdateList" targetRef="Task_UpdateMaterialsList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_UpdateMaterialsList" targetRef="EndEvent_ListUpdated"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" name="Friends want bragging" sourceRef="Gateway_OutcomeSplit" targetRef="Task_BragToFriends">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${bragging}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" name="Materials to be sent" sourceRef="Gateway_OutcomeSplit" targetRef="Task_SendMaterials">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${sendingMaterials}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_BragToFriends" targetRef="Gateway_OutcomeJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_OutcomeJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Gateway_OutcomeJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_BotFinished"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
